TESLA: Crystal Sun Solar Project, Fort Bend County, TX, August 8th, 2026

This flyover is over the proposed project area for Tesla’s Project Crystal Sun, a planned $10.1 billion solar cell and module manufacturing facility.

It is located in Fort Bend County, Texas, near the intersection of FM 1994 and FM 762. The site covers more than 3,000 acres across multiple parcels, within Lamar Consolidated ISD jurisdiction, roughly 40 minutes south/southeast of the Brookshire, TX, Megafactory.

Visible features include the W.A. Parish Generating Station to the east, Cutlass Solar Farms to the southwest and the Big Creek corridor.
